module collections.sorted_integers
  purpose: Merge sorted integer lists.

public function merge_sorted_unique(left: List of Integer, right: List of Integer)
  returns List of Integer
  purpose: Merge two sorted integer lists into one sorted list without duplicates.
  example: merge_sorted_unique(left: [1, 2, 2, 4], right: [2, 3, 4, 5]) is [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
  example: merge_sorted_unique(left: [], right: []) is []

  let sorted_values be left.append_all(right).sorted()
  let mutable merged: List of Integer be []
  let mutable previous: maybe Integer be nothing

  for each value in sorted_values
    match previous
      when some(previous_value) then
        if value is not previous_value then
          set merged to merged.append(value)
          set previous to value
        end
      when nothing then
        set merged to merged.append(value)
        set previous to value
    end
  end

  return merged
end

test "two empty lists merge to an empty list"
  check merge_sorted_unique(left: [], right: []) is []
end

module library.merge_sorted
  purpose: Merge sorted integer lists.

public function merge_sorted_unique(left: List of Integer, right: List of Integer)
  returns List of Integer
  purpose: Merge two sorted lists of integers into one sorted list without duplicates.
  example: merge_sorted_unique(left: [1, 2, 4], right: [2, 3, 4]) is [1, 2, 3, 4]
  example: merge_sorted_unique(left: [], right: [1, 1, 2]) is [1, 2]

  let mutable merged: List of Integer be []
  let mutable left_index be 0
  let mutable right_index be 0

  repeat until left_index is at least left.length() and right_index is at least right.length()
    let next_value be
      if left_index is at least left.length() then
        right.at(right_index) otherwise crash with "right index out of range"
      otherwise if right_index is at least right.length() then
        left.at(left_index) otherwise crash with "left index out of range"
      otherwise
        let left_value be left.at(left_index) otherwise crash with "left index out of range"
        let right_value be right.at(right_index) otherwise crash with "right index out of range"
        if left_value is at most right_value then left_value otherwise right_value end
      end

    if merged.is_empty() then
      set merged to merged.append(next_value)
    otherwise if merged.last() otherwise crash with "merged list is empty" is not next_value then
      set merged to merged.append(next_value)
    end

    repeat until left_index is at least left.length() or (left.at(left_index) otherwise crash with "left index out of range") is not next_value
      set left_index to left_index + 1
    end

    repeat until right_index is at least right.length() or (right.at(right_index) otherwise crash with "right index out of range") is not next_value
      set right_index to right_index + 1
    end
  end

  return merged
end

test "two empty lists merge to an empty list"
  check merge_sorted_unique(left: [], right: []) is []
end
